free_tier.stated: Yes! We offer unlimited storage and serving of public repositories.

per_object_cap.notes: The Red Hat support article states unlimited storage and serving of public repositories but gives no per-object size cap.

retention.stated: Every paid plan is priced only by private-repo count and lists 'Unlimited public repos'; a free account gets unlimited public repos, private repos require a 30-day trial then a paid plan
retention.notes: The 30-day period is the free trial for a selected account, not a data retention term.

egress.terms: Unlimited serving of public repositories is included in the free offer.

tooling: oras push / docker push / skopeo; Cosign/notation signing supported natively.
chaining: Public repositories have unlimited storage and serving.
limits_note: Requires a Red Hat SSO account to push (anonymous pull only). Quay is a shared hosted registry: pull QPS and total storage are subject to undisclosed fair use; the paid tiers exist purely to buy private repos, which signals public storage is deliberately not metered.
reliability_note: Hosted multitenancy means a noisy-neighbour throttle is possible but not documented; no data-expiry policy on public repos, so blobs persist indefinitely.
